tasks.label: build active C++ file
args: if [[ "${file}" != *.cpp && "${file}" != *.cc && "${file}" != *.cxx ]]; then echo "error: '${fileBasename}' is not a .cpp file, so it can't be compiled." >&2; echo "Click into the tab for your .cpp file (make it the active editor), then press F5 again." >&2; exit 1; fi; /usr/bin/g++ -std=c++17 -g -Wall -Wextra -pedantic "${file}" -o "${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}"
